span.p:
Environment network vnet-aks-dev
snet-shared-pe: private endpoints of the zone and platform Key Vaults,
registry (prd), Terraform state, AI models – reached through the hub Firewall

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hub VNet of the exposure
Azure Firewall Premium (labfw in the dev lab)
DNS proxy, SNAT, per-zone IP groups

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Route tables, BGP propagation off (D73)
rt-<cell> on snet-system: 0.0.0.0/0 → hub Firewall
rt-<cell>-<zone> on each zone's node subnet: 0.0.0.0/0 + every other zone's slot → hub Firewall
(a zone's own slot and slot 0 stay on the VNet's route; overlay pod addresses are routed by Azure's overlay - Cilium's alone)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NSG per subnet nsg-<cell>-<subnet>
deny-all inbound last; allows only kubelet 10250 from snet-system, Cilium health, DNS,
the overlay pod range between node subnets, LB probes, 443 from Internet / VirtualNetwork
